meanings.meaning: To succeed in something, now especially in academic performance. .mw-parser-output .defdate{font-size:smaller}
To carry out successfully; to accomplish.
examples: You can achieve anything if you put your mind to it.
Hannah achieved her lifelong dream of winning a medal at the Olympics.

meanings.meaning: To obtain, or gain (a desired result, objective etc.), as the result of exertion; to succeed in gaining; to win.
